killed.claim: Prior hard survivor (s0): AC-20260915-03-6's pin assertion at tests/browser/hmr.test.ts:121 was a bare synchronous snapshot that raced the frame's pin re-anchor after a host edit, making the gate intermittently red.
killed.evidence: Fix verified in place: git diff shows the bare snapshot replaced by `await expect.poll(() => pin.count(), { timeout: 5_000 }).toBeGreaterThan(0)` (now line 125) plus a 4-line comment; no other hunk in the file. Executed `npx vitest run tests/browser/hmr.test.ts` 6x sequentially at idle: all `Tests 1 passed | 1 skipped (2)`, exit 0. Executed the same file 4x while 8 busy loops saturated the 6-core box (loadavg 3.10 -> 7.17): all 4 green, exit 0. Pre-fix baseline was 2 failures in 4 runs. Full suite `npx vitest run`: Test Files 24 passed (24), Tests 113 passed | 5 skipped (118), exit 0. npm run typecheck exit 0, npm run lint exit 0.

killed.claim: The 5 s poll masks a real ordering bug rather than removing the race (the pin only comes back near the timeout, or not reliably at all).
killed.evidence: Mechanism read: the observer/rootRef effect keys on [frameLoad, viewport] and calls bump() (double rAF -> setTick), and the box-resolving useLayoutEffect keys on tick — so after a frame reload the overlay is necessarily empty for one double-rAF tick before re-anchoring; a transient zero is the designed re-anchor path (spec-02 frozen code, unchanged in this range), not a defect. Scratch Playwright probe sampling iframe text and pin.count() every ~10ms across 5 fresh serves: run1 text@128ms pinZero@128ms pinBack@206ms final=1; run2 text@92ms no zero final=1; run3 text@90ms no zero final=1; run4 text@132ms pinZero@132ms pinBack@223ms final=1; run5 text@140ms pinZero@140ms pinBack@208ms final=1. The pin is back 68-91ms after the edited text appears in every run that showed the gap, and ends at 1 in all five — the poll converges two orders of magnitude inside its 5s ceiling, so the timeout is slack, not a mask. A genuine regression (pin never re-anchoring) would still fail the poll at 5s.
